title: LAB-EU German First State Exam Core Study (45 cases)

arms.sandbox_note: docker on workstations, bwrap on cluster nodes; the run manifest records which profile produced each run.

prompts.note: The two automated arms use their own task templates; only the manual workbench condition uses study_system_prompt.txt. The three texts carry the same substantive instructions (language, self-contained deliverable, Gutachtenstil, controlling case law, precise citations) but differ in wording, and only the baseline forbids preamble/meta commentary because its entire response is saved as the deliverable.
